name: u2-toast-360-200-dark
steps: (()=>{const r=e=>e.getBoundingClientRect();const hit=(a,b)=>a.left<b.right&&b.left<a.right&&a.top<b.bottom&&b.top<a.bottom;const toasts=[...document.querySelectorAll('.toast')];if(!toasts.length)throw Error('No toast');const stops=[...document.querySelectorAll('.app__safety .named-stop__button')];if(!stops.length)throw Error('No rail Stop');const footer=document.querySelector('.tab:not(.is-hidden) .route:not(.is-hidden) .screen > .screen__footer');for(const t of toasts){if(footer&&hit(r(t),r(footer)))throw Error('Toast covers the pinned footer')}for(const s of stops){const b=r(s);if(b.top<0||b.bottom>innerHeight+1)throw Error('Stop off screen');for(const t of toasts)if(hit(r(t),b))throw Error('Toast covers Stop');if(!s.contains(document.elementFromPoint((b.left+b.right)/2,(b.top+b.bottom)/2)))throw Error('Stop does not receive the click')}})()

name: u3-land-talk-100-dark
steps: (()=>{const r=e=>e.getBoundingClientRect();for(const s of document.querySelectorAll('.app__safety .named-stop__button')){const b=r(s);if(b.top<0||b.left<0||b.bottom>innerHeight+1||b.right>innerWidth+1)throw Error('Stop off screen')}const main=r(document.querySelector('.app__main'));if(main.height<0.6*innerHeight)throw Error('Main is '+Math.round(main.height)+'px');const talk=document.querySelector('.tab:not(.is-hidden) .route:not(.is-hidden) .talk');if(!talk)return;const rem=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).fontSize);const body=r(talk.querySelector(':scope > .screen__body'));const foot=r(talk.querySelector(':scope > .screen__footer'));const comp=r(talk.querySelector('.composer'));if(comp.top<main.top||comp.bottom>main.bottom+1)throw Error('Composer out of view');const seen=Math.min(body.bottom,foot.top)-Math.max(body.top,main.top);if(seen<3*rem)throw Error('Conversation shows '+Math.round(seen)+'px')})()
